title: Cinnamomum zeylanicum essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Cinnamomum zeylanicum essential oil is a concentrated aromatic extract derived from the bark of the cinnamon tree. It is widely used in herbalism for its warming and stimulating properties. This essential oil is known for its ability to support respiratory health, reduce inflammation, and promote circulation. It is often used in aromatherapy, massage, and topical applications to relieve muscle pain and congestion. In traditional medicine, it has been valued for its antimicrobial and digestive benefits.
